name: Disable Display, Sleep and Hibernate Timeouts
description: Disables display sleep, system sleep, and hibernate timeouts to keep the screen on during use.

description_i18n.en: Disables display sleep, system sleep, and hibernate timeouts to keep the screen on during use.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert Bildschirm-, System- und Hibernate-Zeitlimits, um den Bildschirm während der Nutzung anzuhalten.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive les délais d'arrêt de l'écran, du système et de la mise en veille pour garder l'affichage allumé.

warnings.title: Power consumption increases
warnings.message: The screen will remain on longer, which may increase battery drain or power usage depending on your device settings

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies power plan settings for display idle timeout and system sleep states by setting values to zero Uses the standard Windows Power Configuration tool (powercfg) via command line
